# Electrical circuits: catalogue

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_catalogue.py from the code; do not edit by hand. -->

Electrical circuits by Modified Nodal Analysis: resistors, capacitors, inductors, sources and their waveforms, diodes, switches, transformers and controlled sources (Modelica Standard Library device laws). How the pieces fit together: [Electrical circuits](../applications/electrical.md).
Every application is set up the same way; see [Using noodl](../usage.md).

Import from `noodl.apps.electrical`. The full reference, with every parameter, is in the [API reference](../api.md).

## Network components

Descriptions of the physical objects a network is built from.

| Name | What it does | How to call it |
|---|---|---|
| `Constant` | A constant: unit value 1 at every time (a DC source: value `offset + amplitude`). | `Constant()` |
| `Pulse` | A pulse train: 1 for the first `width` percent of every `period` (s) from `start_time`, else 0; `n_periods < 0` repeats for ever, otherwise the pulse train stops after `n_periods` periods (MSL `Blocks.Sources.Pulse`). | `Pulse(width, period, start_time=0.0, n_periods=-1)` |
| `Ramp` | A ramp: 0 before `start_time` (s), rising linearly to 1 over `duration` (s), then 1 (MSL `Blocks.Sources.Ramp`; `duration = 0` is a step). | `Ramp(duration, start_time=0.0)` |
| `Signal` | An external signal: the unit value is read from the driver `drivers[key][..., index]` at evaluation time (batched like any driver), so a source can follow an external input (MSL `SignalVoltage`, `SignalCurrent`). It needs no clock and has no breakpoints. | `Signal(key, index=0)` |
| `Sine` | A sine wave: 0 before `start_time` (s), then `sin(2 pi frequency (t - start_time) + phase)` (`frequency` in Hz, `phase` in rad; MSL `Blocks.Sources.Sine` with `continuous = false`). | `Sine(frequency, phase=0.0, start_time=0.0)` |
| `Step` | A step: 0 before `start_time` (s), 1 from `start_time` on (MSL `Blocks.Sources.Step`: `if time < startTime then 0 else height`). | `Step(start_time=0.0)` |

## Elements (branch laws)

Flow through an edge as a function of the potential difference across it.

| Name | What it does | How to call it |
|---|---|---|
| `Capacitance` | A capacitor `q = C d(dp)/dt` (`C` in F, initial voltage `v0` in V), as companion forms: dc `q = 0`; initial `dp = v0`; phasor `q = j omega C dp`; transient backward Euler `q = C (dp - dp_prev) / dt` or trapezoidal `q + q_prev = 2 C / dt (dp - dp_prev)`. MSL `Basic.Capacitor`. | `Capacitance(C, *, v0=0.0, kind='capacitor', learnable=False)` |
| `DependentSource` | A linear controlled source with edges `[control, output]` per device: the control port is an open circuit (`q1 = 0`, voltage control) or a short (`dp1 = 0`, current control), and the output port imposes `dp2` (voltage output) or `q2` (current output) as `gain` times the control voltage `dp1` or current `q1`. Default kinds `"vcvs"`, `"vccs"`, `"ccvs"`, `"cccs"`. MSL `Basic.VCV`, `VCC`, `CCV`, `CCC` (gain, transconductance in S, transresistance in ohm, current gain). | `DependentSource(gain, *, control, output, kind=None, learnable=False)` |
| `Inductance` | An inductor `dp = L dq/dt` (`L` in H, initial current `i0` in A), as companion forms: dc `dp = 0`; initial `q = i0`; phasor `dp = j omega L q`; transient backward Euler `dp = L (q - q_prev) / dt` or trapezoidal `dp + dp_prev = 2 L / dt (q - q_prev)`. MSL `Basic.Inductor`. | `Inductance(L, *, i0=0.0, kind='inductor', learnable=False)` |
| `JunctionDiode` | A junction diode with a parallel leak: `q = Ids (exlin(dp / Vt) - 1) + dp / R`, where `exlin(x) = exp(x)` up to `Maxexp` and continues linearly above it, `exp(Maxexp) (1 + x - Maxexp)` (`Ids` saturation current in A, `Vt` voltage equivalent of temperature in V, `R` parallel resistance in ohm). MSL `Semiconductors.Diode` without temperature dependency. Nonlinear, so not usable in a phasor layer. | `JunctionDiode(Ids=1e-06, Vt=0.04, Maxexp=15.0, R=100000000.0, *, kind='diode')` |
| `MutualInductance` | Two coupled windings: `dp1 = L1 dq1/dt + M dq2/dt`, `dp2 = M dq1/dt + L2 dq2/dt` (`L1`, `L2`, `M` in H; initial currents `i0 = (i1, i2)` in A, per device or shared). Companion forms as `Inductance` with the 2x2 inductance matrix. Edges `[primary, secondary]` per device. MSL `Basic.Transformer`. | `MutualInductance(L1, L2, M, *, i0=(0.0, 0.0), kind='transformer', learnable=False)` |
| `PrescribedCurrent` | An ideal current source: `q = offset + amplitude * unit(t)` (A) entering pin `p` whatever the voltage, with the waveform and its phasor as for `PrescribedVoltage`. MSL `Sources.ConstantCurrent`, `StepCurrent`, `SineCurrent`, `PulseCurrent`, `SignalCurrent`. `learnable` applies to `amplitude`. | `PrescribedCurrent(amplitude, *, waveforms=None, offset=0.0, kind='current_source', learnable=False)` |
| `PrescribedVoltage` | An ideal voltage source: `dp = offset + amplitude * unit(t)` (V), with `unit` the waveform (`Constant` by default; one for all edges or one per edge) evaluated at the evaluation time `t` (s). In phasor mode a `Sine(frequency, phase, start_time)` source is `dp = amplitude * exp(j (phase - omega start_time))` (peak-amplitude, sine-referenced; at the layer's frequency) and a `Constant` source is `dp = amplitude`; other waveforms are refused there. MSL `Sources.ConstantVoltage`, `StepVoltage`, `SineVoltage`, `PulseVoltage`, `SignalVoltage`. `learnable` applies to `amplitude`. | `PrescribedVoltage(amplitude, *, waveforms=None, offset=0.0, kind='voltage_source', learnable=False)` |
| `Resistance` | A linear resistor: `q = dp / R_actual` with `R_actual = R (1 + alpha (T - T_ref))` (`R` in ohm at `T_ref` in K, `alpha` in 1/K); `T` (K) is read per edge from `drivers[temperature]` when `temperature` names a driver, else `T = T_ref`. MSL `Basic.Resistor`. | `Resistance(R, *, alpha=0.0, T_ref=300.15, temperature=None, kind='resistor', learnable=False)` |
| `SwitchedConductance` | An ideal closing switch: closed `q = dp / Ron`, open `q = Goff dp` (`Ron` in ohm, `Goff` in S); closed where the control value exceeds 0.5 (or is True). `control` is a driver key whose last dimension holds one value per switch edge (or one value for all), a single `(key, index)` pair read by every switch, or a sequence with one entry per edge, each a key (read at index 0) or a `(key, index)` pair. MSL `Ideal.IdealClosingSwitch`. | `SwitchedConductance(control, *, Ron=1e-05, Goff=1e-05, kind='switch')` |
| `TransformerRatio` | An ideal transformer without magnetisation: `dp1 = n dp2`, `q2 = -n q1` (turns ratio `n`, primary to secondary voltage). Edges `[primary p1 -> n1, secondary p2 -> n2]` per device. MSL `Ideal.IdealTransformer` with `considerMagnetization = false`. | `TransformerRatio(n, *, kind='ideal_transformer', learnable=False)` |
